about_the_game:
WAG is a fast-paced roguelike FPS where you face relentless hordes of zombies in a dark, haunted forest. Survive the night, grow stronger with each death, and unlock new weapons and abilities to challenge the darkness.

Each run starts from scratch—explore the forest at night, gather weapons, resources, and upgrades to push your survival as far as you can. No two attempts are the same: randomly generated environments, unpredictable zombies, and multiple ways to evolve make every session unique and challenging.

When you fall, it’s not the end—come back even stronger. Unlock permanent weapons and upgrades for your character, increasing your odds with every new attempt. With 8 different weapons and a deep customization system, you can create over 100 unique loadouts, letting you adapt your playstyle and strategy to every challenge.

The art style blends low poly charm with bold flat shading, creating a unique atmosphere of horror and action.

  • Intense, agile FPS combat against zombie hordes.

  • Roguelike progression: die, evolve, and come back stronger.

  • Procedurally generated environments for endless replayability.

  • Weapon and customization system with hundreds of possible combinations.

  • Unique art direction and immersive, dark atmosphere.

Can you survive the endless night?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence, including exchanges of gunfire between characters and zombie deaths, with traces of blood.
